definitions.name: R3A.RUNIDS
definitions.body: 'R3A.IV' BIND R3A.IV R3A.IV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'R3A.IE' BIND 'R3A.IC' BIND R3A.IE R3A.IC 1 GET R3A.IC 1 GET 1 ADD R3A.IC 0 GET R3A.IE EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> same-length Vector of run ids (0,0,1,...) that step up whenever the value changes from its left neighbour

definitions.name: R3A.RLE
definitions.body: 'R3A.RV' BIND R3A.RV R3A.RUNIDS R3A.RV GROUP VALUES [ 'R3A.RG' BIND R3A.RG 0 GET R3A.RG LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> run-length encoding, a Vector of [ value count ] pairs in order

definitions.name: R3A.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'R3A.UV' BIND R3A.UV R3A.UV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'R3A.UE' BIND 'R3A.UC' BIND R3A.UE R3A.UC 1 GET 1 ADD 1 R3A.UE R3A.UC 0 GET GT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty number Vector -> length of the longest strictly increasing stretch of adjacent values

definitions.name: R3A.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'R3A.MV' BIND R3A.MV LENGTH 'R3A.MN' BIND R3A.MV TALLY 'R3A.MT' BIND R3A.MT KEYS [ 'R3A.MK' BIND R3A.MT R3A.MK GET 2 MUL R3A.MN GT ] FILTER 0 GET
definitions.note: Vector -> the value occurring in more than half the positions, or NIL

definitions.name: R3A.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'R3A.DN' BIND 1 R3A.DN RANGE [ 'R3A.DD' BIND R3A.DN R3A.DD DIV 'R3A.DQ' BIND R3A.DQ R3A.DQ FLOOR EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> Vector of its positive divisors, ascending

definitions.name: R3A.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'R3A.PN' BIND 1 R3A.PN RANGE [ R3A.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> Vector of the primes up to it, ascending

definitions.name: R3A.BINARY
definitions.body: 'R3A.BN' BIND [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] [ R3A.BN GT NOT ] FILTER 'R3A.BP' BIND R3A.BN R3A.BP DIV FLOOR 'R3A.BQ' BIND R3A.BQ R3A.BQ 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR JOIN
definitions.note: integer 1..63 -> its base-2 String without leading zeros

definitions.name: R3A.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'R3A.CN' BIND R3A.CN 1 COLLECT 1 200 RANGE R3A.CN [ 'R3A.CI' BIND 'R3A.CX' BIND R3A.CX 2 DIV 'R3A.CH' BIND 1 R3A.CH R3A.CX 3 MUL 1 ADD R3A.CH R3A.CH FLOOR EQ SELECT R3A.CX 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 GT ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: positive integer (path under 200 steps) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1

definitions.name: R3A.DROOT
definitions.body: 1 SUB 'R3A.RX' BIND R3A.RX R3A.RX 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer -> its digital root, 1 + (n-1) mod 9

definitions.name: R3A.FIBINDEX
definitions.body: 'R3A.FN' BIND 1 40 RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'R3A.FI' BIND 'R3A.FA' BIND R3A.FA 1 GET R3A.FA 0 GET R3A.FA 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ R3A.FN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer n -> smallest k with Fibonacci F(k) >= n (F(1)=F(2)=1)

definitions.name: R3A.USTEP
definitions.body: 'R3A.KC' BIND 'R3A.KS' BIND [ '' ] R3A.KS CHARS CONCAT 'R3A.KK' BIND R3A.KK -1 DROP JOIN R3A.KS R3A.KC 2 COLLECT JOIN R3A.KK -1 GET [ ')' ']' '(' '[' ] [ '(' '[' 'none' 'none' ] RECORD R3A.KC GET EQ SELECT
definitions.note: FOLD/SCAN step: pending-bracket String and next bracket char -> pending String after cancelling a matched pair (else the char is appended)

definitions.name: R3A.BPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS '' [ R3A.USTEP ] SCAN [ 0 0 ] [ 'R3A.QS' BIND 'R3A.QA' BIND R3A.QA 0 GET 1 ADD 'R3A.QP' BIND R3A.QP R3A.QP R3A.QA 1 GET R3A.QS '' EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 if only the empty one)

definitions.name: R3A.PMEAN
definitions.body: R2D.PRESENT 'R3A.MP' BIND R3A.MP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD R3A.MP LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> exact mean of the present elements

definitions.name: R3A.FILLED
definitions.body: 'R3A.LV' BIND R3A.LV R3A.LV R2D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'R3A.LE' BIND 'R3A.LA' BIND R3A.LA R3A.LE R3A.LE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> forward-filled Vector; leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: R3A.RATIOS
definitions.body: [ NIL NIL ] [ 'R3A.TE' BIND 'R3A.TA' BIND R3A.TA 0 GET 'R3A.TP' BIND R3A.TE NIL 1 R3A.TE R3A.TE NIL? SELECT 1 R3A.TP R3A.TP NIL? SELECT DIV R3A.TE NIL? NOT R3A.TP NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP 1 DROP
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector one shorter of each element over its predecessor, NIL where either is missing

definitions.name: R3A.SCALED
definitions.body: 'R3A.WV' BIND R3A.WV R2D.PRESENT 'R3A.WP' BIND R3A.WP R3A.WP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'R3A.WM' BIND R3A.WV [ 'R3A.WE' BIND NIL 0 R3A.WE R3A.WE NIL? SELECT R3A.WM DIV R3A.WE NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> each present element divided by the largest present one; NILs stay NIL

definitions.name: R3A.ORDERS
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
definitions.note: JSON String -> the Vector of order Records under its 'orders' key

definitions.name: R3A.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: 'R3A.OO' BIND R3A.OO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP R3A.OO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'R3A.OG' BIND R3A.OG KEYS R3A.OG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders Vector -> Record from sku to summed qty, skus in first-appearance order

definitions.name: R3A.ARGMAXKEY
definitions.body: 'R3A.AR' BIND R3A.AR KEYS R3A.AR VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record of numbers -> the key with the largest value, the earliest key on a tie

definitions.name: R3A.TITLECASE
definitions.body: CHARS 'R3A.TC' BIND R3A.TC 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER R3A.TC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case
